t: You're looking at a memorial obelisk to George Dance the Younger, who lived from 1741 to 1825. He was an English architect, surveyor and portrait painter, the youngest son of the architect George Dance the Elder, from a family of architects, artists and dramatists. The historian Sir John Summerson described him as among the few really outstanding architects of the century. The sad part is that few of his buildings survive, which makes a memorial like this one all the more worth pausing at.
